evals.name: installed-routes-to-upstream-skill
evals.prompt: /playgrounds:use help me balance the 'Inferno' hero's deck
evals.expected_output: Confirms the upstream playground plugin is installed by its claude-plugins-official install record, then invokes the bare `playground` skill via the Skill tool with the balancing brief, and does not generate any playground HTML itself.
expectations: Presence is judged from the marketplace-qualified install record, not from description wording
The upstream skill is invoked with the user's brief; template choice is left to it
No HTML is authored by this skill in any branch

evals.name: absent-emits-install-commands
evals.prompt: /playgrounds:use I want an interactive explorer for my API's rate-limit settings
evals.expected_output: Finding no playground plugin installed, emits /plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-plugins-official and /plugin install playground@claude-plugins-official with scope guidance, and offers to proceed once installed instead of building a substitute.
expectations: The exact install commands appear, marketplace-qualified
Scope guidance distinguishes user scope from project scope
No attempt to hand-build an explorer as a fallback

evals.name: cloud-session-feature-detects-delivery
evals.prompt: /playgrounds:use tune the easing curves on this animation (we are in a cloud session, there is no local browser)
evals.expected_output: Routes generation upstream, then instead of relying on open <file>.html, feature-detects the delivery path: offers an Artifact publish or a file send only if the session supports it, and otherwise reports the file path, saying plainly which tiers were unavailable.
expectations: open <file>.html is not assumed to work
Each delivery tier is offered conditionally on actual availability, not asserted
Unavailable tiers are named visibly rather than skipped silently

evals.name: shadowed-name-is-not-invoked
evals.prompt: /playgrounds:use make a playground for my color palette (note: this project defines a local skill named playground that formats SQL)
evals.expected_output: Notices the listed playground skill does not describe an interactive-explorer builder, says a local shadow is likely, and takes the install/guidance path rather than invoking the shadowing skill.
expectations: The description mismatch is treated as a shadow signal, not as proof upstream is absent
The shadowing skill is not invoked
The user is told what is shadowing what
